Name: JinHsiang Upgradeable Chests
Author: abroalmor
Description:
Upgradeable Chests adds a dedicated craftable chest that can be upgraded through copper, iron, gold, and iridium tiers. Each tier provides more storage space and additional slots for utility upgrades.
Items, installed upgrades, and chest data are preserved when the chest is upgraded or moved.

[b]Chest tiers[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgradeable Chest: 36 storage slots and no upgrade slots[/*]
[*]Copper Chest: 48 storage slots and 1 upgrade slot[/*]
[*]Iron Chest: 60 storage slots and 2 upgrade slots[/*]
[*]Gold Chest: 72 storage slots and 3 upgrade slots[/*]
[*]Iridium Chest: 96 storage slots and 4 upgrade slots[/*]
[/list]Larger inventories use a paged interface with mouse-wheel controls, page buttons, and a page counter.

[b]How to upgrade a chest[/b]
Hold 5 bars for the next tier and use them directly on the chest.
The upgrade order is:
[list=1]
[*]Copper Bar[/*]
[*]Iron Bar[/*]
[*]Gold Bar[/*]
[*]Iridium Bar[/*]
[/list]Each upgrade consumes 5 bars. All stored items and installed components remain inside the chest.

[b]Utility upgrades[/b]
[b]Chest Mover Upgrade[/b]
Allows an upgraded chest to be picked up while it still contains items.
Install the component in an upgrade slot, then use the tool button on the chest to pick it up. When placed again, the chest keeps its contents, tier, color, and installed upgrades.
Crafting materials:
[list]
[*]5 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]25 Wood[/*]
[/list][b]Push Upgrade[/b]
Slowly transfers items from the upgraded chest to a linked target container.
[list=1]
[*]Hold the Push Upgrade.[/*]
[*]Right-click the target container to record its map and coordinates.[/*]
[*]Right-click an upgraded chest to install the component in its first empty upgrade slot.[/*]
[/list]The component transfers one item at a time. It supports containers located on other maps.
Crafting materials:
[list]
[*]2 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list][b]Pull Upgrade[/b]
Works in the opposite direction, slowly transferring items from a linked container into the upgraded chest.
[list=1]
[*]Hold the Pull Upgrade.[/*]
[*]Right-click the source container to record its map and coordinates.[/*]
[*]Right-click an upgraded chest to install the component in its first empty upgrade slot.[/*]
[/list]Crafting materials:
[list]
[*]2 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list][b]Managing installed upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*]Components are installed from left to right.[/*]
[*]Open the chest and right-click an installed component to remove it.[/*]
[*]Remaining components automatically shift left to fill empty slots.[/*]
[*]Removing a Push or Pull Upgrade clears its saved target, allowing it to be linked to another container.[/*]
[*]Items can continue entering or leaving a chest while its inventory is open.[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Updating from an earlier version[/b]
Replace the previous Upgradeable Chests folder with the new version. Existing mod chests and their contents are preserved.
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]No other mods are required[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Built for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Cross-map Push and Pull transfers are supported.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer has not yet been fully tested.[/*]
[/list][b]For mod authors[/b]
Upgradeable Chests includes a public API that lets other SMAPI mods register additional upgrade components. Installed components retain their own modData, allowing extensions such as transfer speed, filtering, range, or processing upgrades.
API documentation is included in the download as API.md.

[b]Credits[/b]
Stardew Valley and the original chest artwork are by ConcernedApe. The chest sprites included in this mod were redrawn from the game's original chest sprites using ComfyUI.
